description: Identify every code point in a string, or look up code points written as U+XXXX or as decimal numbers. Each code point returns its Unicode name (or code point label and aliases), general category, code point type, block, script, whitespace, default-ignorable, bidi-control, and invisible flags, UTF-8 and UTF-16 encodings, its NFC/NFD/NFKC/NFKD forms, and the grapheme cluster it belongs to. The summary covers the whole input and lists the index of every invisible and bidi-control code point. Use it to find zero-width spaces, non-breaking spaces, bidi overrides, and other hidden characters, or to see how an emoji sequence or a combining mark is built; pass by "text" for any text you did not write yourself. Data is the Unicode Character Database 18.0.0, bundled. In the text output, characters that would not display safely appear as \u{XXXX} escapes.

by.description: How to read query. auto: code point notation when every token is U+ followed by hex digits, otherwise literal text. text: inspect every code point of query as written; pass it for any text you did not write yourself, since auto reads text made only of U+ tokens as the code points they name. code_point: tokens of 1-6 hex digits, optionally written U+XXXX, 0xXXXX, or \u{XXXX}, separated by spaces or commas. decimal: tokens of decimal digits from 0 to 1114111, separated by spaces or commas.

limit.description: Code points to return on this page (default 32, at most 128; a larger value returns 128 with a notice). The summary always describes the whole input.

offset.description: Index of the first code point to return, counting from 0. Pass next_offset from the previous response to continue.

query.description: Text to inspect, or code points to look up. In auto mode a query made only of U+ tokens ("U+200B", "U+0041 U+030A") is read as code points; anything else is inspected code point by code point, whitespace included. At most 4,096 code points; a character above U+FFFF, such as an emoji, counts as one.

name: ref_unicode_lookup

code_points.description: The code points on this page, in input order.

items.description: One code point of the input.

aliases.description: Formal name aliases in NameAliases.txt order; empty when there are none.

alias.description: The alias as NameAliases.txt writes it.

type.description: Alias type: correction (a corrected name), control (a control function name), alternate, figment (documented but never in actual use), or abbreviation.

block.description: Unicode block name; null outside every block.

category.description: General_Category short alias, such as Cf.

category_name.description: General_Category long name, such as Format.

char.description: The character itself when it displays safely; null for control, format, bidi-control, separator, combining, space, default-ignorable, private-use, surrogate, noncharacter, and reserved code points.

cluster_index.description: Grapheme cluster this code point belongs to, from 0; code points sharing it form one user-perceived character.

code_point.description: U+ followed by uppercase hex, at least 4 digits (U+200B, U+1F600).

code_point_type.description: Unicode basic type: graphic, format (Cf, Zl, Zp), control (Cc), private_use, surrogate, noncharacter, or reserved (any other unassigned code point).

decimal.description: The code point value as a decimal number.

index.description: Position among the code points of the input, from 0.

is_bidi_control.description: Bidi_Control property: an explicit bidirectional formatting character.

is_default_ignorable.description: Default_Ignorable_Code_Point property: renders as nothing when a font does not support it.

is_invisible.description: True for default-ignorable, whitespace, and control code points other than TAB, LF, CR, and SPACE.

label.description: Code point label such as <control-0009> or <reserved-0378>; present exactly when name is null.

name.description: Unicode Name property; null for control, private-use, surrogate, noncharacter, and reserved code points, which have none.

normalization.description: The four normalization forms of this code point, never empty; a form that leaves it unchanged repeats it.

nfc.description: NFC (canonical composition) of this code point alone.

nfd.description: NFD (canonical decomposition) of this code point alone.

nfkc.description: NFKC (compatibility composition) of this code point alone.

nfkd.description: NFKD (compatibility decomposition) of this code point alone.

script.description: Script property value, such as Latin or Old_Italic; Unknown for unassigned, private-use, and surrogate code points.

utf16.description: UTF-16 code units as 4-digit uppercase hex separated by a space (D83D DE00).

utf16_offset.description: UTF-16 code unit offset of this code point in the string the code points spell (JavaScript and LSP positions).

utf8.description: UTF-8 bytes as uppercase hex separated by spaces (E2 80 8B); null for a surrogate, which UTF-8 cannot encode.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_code_point`: A code point or decimal token is malformed, the query holds no tokens, or a value is above U+10FFFF. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

interpreted_as.description: How query was read: literal text, code point notation, or decimal numbers.

next_offset.description: Pass as offset to continue; null on the last page.

notice.description: How the reading or the page differs from what was asked: a query that looks like a code point number read as text, a limit clamped to 128, or an offset past the end.

summary.description: Facts about the whole input, not only this page.

bidi_control_indices.description: Index of every bidi-control code point in the whole input, ascending.

items.description: Index of a bidi-control code point.

code_point_count.description: Code points in the whole input.

grapheme_cluster_count.description: Extended grapheme clusters (user-perceived characters) in the whole input.

invisible_indices.description: Index of every invisible code point in the whole input, ascending.

items.description: Index of an invisible code point.

utf16_length.description: UTF-16 code units the whole input takes (a surrogate counts as 1).

utf8_length.description: UTF-8 bytes the whole input takes; null when it holds a surrogate.

well_formed.description: False when the input holds a surrogate code point.

truncated.description: True when code points remain after this page.

unicode_version.description: Version of the bundled Unicode Character Database the data comes from.

title: Unicode Character Lookup
